scope: Recent exact provider/model chat evidence controls default visibility and activation; untested provider and model catalog entries are available only through a session-only Beta switch.

Normal chat, Quickchat, and Space Assistant use a single model selection; saved multi-agent defaults are migrated to a qualified single model with a hint when available, otherwise blocked with an explanation until deliberate Beta selection.
New Tab is prominent above pinned apps; creating a tab activates its start page and focuses search, while switching to an existing tab does not auto-focus it.

evidence_identity_and_limits.runtime_binding: Electron assigns a fresh opaque UUID before each Sidekick process launch and passes it through LASTBROWSER_RUNTIME_GENERATION; backend evidence carries that generation. A stopped or replaced runtime cannot reuse prior evidence.
evidence_identity_and_limits.build_binding: Renderer evidence includes a deterministic SHA-256 build identity derived from tracked and untracked renderer source, brand assets, desktop package metadata, and Vite configuration.
evidence_identity_and_limits.account_config_binding: Provider-specific account IDs are not exposed. Supported provider configuration and OAuth change flows rotate opaque per-provider generations in renderer and backend; generation mismatch or missing identity fails closed. This is change invalidation through supported flows, not verification of a provider account identity.
evidence_identity_and_limits.secret_handling: No raw credentials or hashes of credentials are stored in renderer evidence.

new_tab_electron_dom_flow.scope: Source UI DOM harness using installed Windows Electron; expanded and slim sidebar, native Ctrl+T route, start page focus, typing and submit, and existing-tab no-autofocus. Not packaged guest evidence.
